text: Planning a trip is exciting, but it can also be stressful. First, you choose a destination and book flights and hotels. When you arrive, you experience new cultures, which is often the best part of travelling. You can try local food, listen to different music, and see how people live. However, language barriers can make things difficult. Sometimes you cannot understand signs or order food easily. Despite these challenges, travel creates unforgettable memories. You learn about yourself and the world, and you return home with stories to share for years.
